thread:
maria: Heads-up — I'm going to push a lightweight IA tweak PR for the console nav. The idea: collapse a couple of adjacent top-level items into a single compact group called 'Workflows' (contains Models, Pipelines, Jobs). This reduces vertical noise and gives more room for model cards. Screenshot + quick notes: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/compact-nav-v1.png

maria: Quick asks before I lock the PR: any concerns about breadcrumb semantics, back/forward behavior, or how we handle deep links into a nested item?

devon: I'm worried about back/forward — if we change the tree so Models becomes a nested path (/workflows/models) we need to preserve history entries when users drill into a model detail. Otherwise browser back becomes confusing. Might need to push history entries for group open/close.

sam: a11y note: when the nav collapses groups, keyboard users should still be able to tab into the group and use arrow keys to explore children. Also ensure aria-expanded updates on group toggle. If we're auto-collapsing on small widths, announce the change with skip-to links.

ana: copy nudge: can we avoid renaming 'Jobs' -> 'Runs'? Users call them Jobs today. If we change labels here it will break existing crumbs and cause support churn. Suggest keeping existing labels and only change hierarchy.

frank: analytics/telemetry: we rely on the top-level slug to attribute routes to product areas. If we move Models under Workflows, we should map old slugs to new ones in the telemetry layer so historical dashboards don't fragment. Also preserve query params like ?panel=inspect — those are used by support deep-links.

maria: good calls. For history I'm thinking we treat group open as a replaceState and resource navigation as pushState. That gives back button behavior on model detail but avoids spamming history for simple nav folds. Example router pseudocode:```js
// when opening group header
history.replaceState(null, '', '/workflows');
// when navigating to a model
history.pushState(null, '', `/workflows/models/${modelId}`);
``` 

maria: For telemetry we can keep the existing routeName tag by setting routeAlias when serving the page. That way dashboards still show "models" hits under the legacy bucket.

devon: Small UX nit: breadcrumbs should show the compact grouping but also keep the original short label: "Models" not "Workflows / Models" if the user came from a direct model link. Maybe render as: "Models · (in Workflows)" — visible but not noisy.

sam: Agree on breadcrumb simplification. Also double-check focus return when closing a detail panel — focus should go back to the model list row, not the group header.

ana: Copy tweak suggestion for the breadcrumb fallback: instead of "in Workflows" use "within Workflows" — reads better in truncated UI.

frank: One more: deep links from support emails use fragment links (#inspect-123). Make sure our router accepts both query & fragment style deep links and reconciles them to a single canonical route for analytics.

design-bot: Reminder — Design review scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PT in #design-review. Please upload updated mocks to the review doc before 9am.

maria: I'll update the PR with keyboard handling notes, telemetry mapping, and the breadcrumb variants. Pushing draft in ~30m. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:

devon: i'll test back/forward once draft is up. :+1:

sam: I'll run an a11y pass on the updated components after the PR lands.

ana: will add copy options to the doc.

frank: ping me for telemetry mapping, I'll supply the alias table.

maria: great — closing loop here. If no major objections we'll ship the compact grouping on canary only and toggle via feature flag.
